name: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Sailor Stars: Fuwa-fuwa Panic 2
summary: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Sailor Stars: Fuwa-fuwa Panic 2 is a video game released exclusively in Japan by Bandai on September 27, 1996. the Super Famicom and is the sequel to Sailor Moon SuperS: Fuwa Fuwa Panic. The game made use of Bandai's SuFami Turbo accessory and could not be played without it.
